19.09.2023 Present: Mr. Pawan Gautam, Advocate, for the petitioners.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, learned Additional of Advocate General, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent.
